title: Print Even Digits in Reverse Order

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the expected output following problem rules.
Input produces the expected output following problem rules.

solution.approach: Extract and print even digits in reverse order separated by space.

code.Python3:
import sys
def main():
    toks = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not toks: return
    evens = [c for c in reversed(toks[0]) if int(c) % 2 == 0]
    print(" ".join(evens))
if __name__ == "__main__": main()
